card.title: Record My Contribution
card.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The minutes weren't there with a ladder. They need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.

mechanism: A insists a repair contribution and even promised thanks become part of a durable formal record.
confusable: Unlike seeking immediate praise, A rejects shared memory and future ceremony as substitutes for recorded credit.
comparison: Village minutes acquire both a repair line and pending thanks; the prize certificate records individual roles before framing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
